properties.name: liquidware:sbom:scope
properties.value: Describes the PowerShell script distribution, which has no third-party components: the tool binds only to Windows-inbox .NET Framework assemblies (PresentationFramework, PresentationCore, WindowsBase, System.Windows.Forms, System.Drawing), and its embedded brand assets are first-party Liquidware artwork.

properties.name: liquidware:sbom:finalisation
properties.value: Build-Exe.ps1 rewrites this file when it compiles the executable, adding ps2exe at the version actually resolved at build time plus the executable's SHA-256. The copy shipped alongside an .exe is that rewritten one; re-run the Grype scan against it, per section 5 of the Sparks Tool Project Review Checklist.
